correctness.rationale: The Boolean Markov factor follows exactly from Poisson input and batch gates. A fully positive 8-cell rational stationary distribution passes all 8 exact generator-balance identities and normalization. The chain is irreducible by constructive clearing and loading. All three Rayleigh differences are explicit positive-leading quadratics with the common exact discriminant r^6(r^2-16r-16)/(256(1+r)^10), making the endpoint classification exact by BBL Theorem 4.1. The field-tilted covariance equals minus the middle-field Rayleigh difference divided by a positive squared partition function. The embedded symbolic script rederives these equalities and independently verifies 4-site projection at two rational rates. No finite check is used to prove the all-size projection claim.

value.rationale: Strong Rayleigh is a canonical robust negative-dependence property, preserved under arbitrary positive external fields, so determining exactly where its protection breaks down for a physically motivated coalescing transport model answers a structural rather than an arbitrary finite-census question. Above r*=8+4sqrt(5), a simple positive middle-site reweighting reverses the outer-site covariance even though the unweighted pairwise signs stay negative; this separates ordinary correlation from external-field-robust repulsion. The exact threshold gives an all-length failure certificate via upstream autonomy and a reproducible benchmark for coalescing lattice statistics. It does not claim the strong-Rayleigh property for longer chains below threshold.
